html:
UE 5.6 alpha.8 — connection indicator and Unreal-to-Blender send

Changes

  • Plugin 0.2.13-alpha.8 adds a status lamp beside the connection text in the Unreal ForgeMCP panel. Green pulses while a fresh authenticated heartbeat is present, yellow marks an interrupted/stale heartbeat, and red means the bridge is stopped or has not authenticated a ForgeMCP client yet.
  • MCP server 0.3.13 deduplicates physical registration directories before selecting the Blender artifact staging root. Unreal and Blender can register under the same engine-wide user directory, which appears twice in the manager's configured root list. Counting list entries instead of unique folders caused the staging step to fail with session_registration_unavailable.

Diagnosis evidence

The retained Unreal-to-Blender OBJ and FBX receipts show native export completed with valid geometry and artifact hashes. Both then failed before import, at staging, with session_registration_unavailable. No Blender object was created by those failed attempts. Fresh FBX and OBJ previews both succeeded against the current live Unreal and Blender sessions.

Validation

  • tests/test_roundtrip.py and tests/test_ui_transfer.py: 33 passed after the root-deduplication change.
  • Full Python suite: 353 passed.
  • Isolated UE 5.6.1 editor target build: passed (28 UBT actions).
  • Alpha.8 archive package check and clean-project plugin load: passed.
  • Package: Artifacts/ForgeMCP-Unreal-Alpha-0.2.13-alpha.8-UE5.6.1-Win64.zip. SHA256: b73a19c12f05c8a07816ef0c9beb9ca07c7167c2f8104078a8b98c90b962efc8.
  • Disposable Unreal and Blender end-to-end panel-worker transfer: FBX and OBJ both passed, including native export, staged artifact integrity, Blender import and geometry verification. User app sessions and scenes were not used.
  • Alpha.8 installed engine-wide at [local path] Files\EpicGames\UE_5.6\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace\Forge after the user confirmed Unreal was closed. The descriptor reports 0.2.13-alpha.8 (version 23); the installer preserved a reversible backup and modified no project files. Interactive visual verification of the lamp is pending the next Unreal launch.
